description: Live non-custodial liquidity, as positions an agent can actually trade against. Each row carries the strategy hash, network, pair, tokens, settled volume and a `quote_eligible` flag saying whether /api/quote can simulate it. Use this before a swap to find a real on-chain counterparty, or to survey where liquidity sits. Filter by network and by pair. Free, no key, no custody.

chain.description: Network key, e.g. "base" or "ethereum". Defaults to every network.

pair.description: Pair filter, a substring match, e.g. "USDC" or "WETH". Omit for every pair.

quote_ready.description: True returns only positions that can be simulated. False returns the positions that cannot.

name: trdefi_positions
title: Open positions
